answers.ask: How long is very long - a few hundred studs across the view, or running the whole length of the map?
answers.answer: Have it run the whole length of the map so it feels very long.

answers.ask: What kind of setting is the river in - forest, desert, town?
answers.answer: Use a simple forest setting around the river.

answers.ask: In front of you where exactly - should it start at your current position, or be centred on the existing build?
answers.answer: Centre it on the existing build, positioned directly in front of me.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D layout with a very long river running the full length of the map, centred on the existing build and positioned directly in front of the player. Surround the river with a simple forest setting along both banks.
agent_notes: This is an edit to an existing build - a very long river through a simple forest, centred on what is already there - and it names no game type at all, so it is No Genre rather than a genre guessed from the setting. There is no shape row to take; every axis sits at its default, which routes P0. The one pick is water-body, bent to the prompt as a river running the full length of the map directly in front of the existing build, and I judged its CHECK resolves to nothing here: the river is a feature on one continuous surface rather than a 3D volume that self-occludes, so the play-space axis stays grounded. No preset was taken and nothing else was added - the forest is set dressing for the image pass, and padding the map with landmarks or paths the author never mentioned would build more than they asked for.
